title: Concept: .yarnrc file served from the web root
description: The file names the registry and the proxy the build trusted, and its scope overrides publish the internal package namespaces. That is both a supply-chain hint and a list of internal names an attacker can target.
applicability: Responses from a deployment that ships its build configuration.
risk: The caller learns the package registry, the proxy host and the internal package scopes.
